dispatches.text: March, AD 68. Word comes from Gaul: Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, has risen against Nero.
XI Claudia takes your promises.
Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, raises the Gauls against Nero.
Dalmatia is yours.
At Hispania Tarraconensis, the old governor Servius Sulpicius Galba lets his men hail him: legate of the Senate and People, he says, not yet emperor.
Titus Arrius, legate of V Macedonica, claims the purple in Judaea.
Quintus Vibius swears to you when your province falls: a legate of one of your legions. He can command an army for you.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and you.
In Africa, Clodius Macer, legate of III Augusta, holds back the grain ships and raises a legion of his own.
An alliance is agreed between Lucius Clodius Macer and you.
Nero is dead. Abandoned by the Praetorians, he took his own life outside Rome. The Senate rules, for now.
Quintus Numisius, legate of XXII Deiotariana, claims the purple in Aegyptus.
Titus Arrius has lost his last legion. His cause is finished.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Lucius Clodius Macer.
The Mauretanian chiefs send 3000 men to Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Lucius Clodius Macer buys New legion of Mauretania Caesariensis.
Lucius Vettius, legate of V Alaudae, claims the purple in Germania Inferior.
Antiochus IV of Commagene sends 4000 men to Quintus Numisius.
A truce is agreed between Lucius Vettius and you.
Your legions hail you as imperator.
Quintus Annius, legate of III Gallica, claims the purple in Moesia.
Battle near Tarraco: Lucius Clodius Macer wins against Servius Sulpicius Galba.
An alliance is agreed between Quintus Annius and you.
On the Rhine, the legions refuse their oath and hail Aulus Vitellius emperor.
Marcus Salvius Otho, once Nero's friend, buys the Praetorians and claims the throne.
The Roxolani cross the frozen Danube into Moesia.
Aulus Licinius, legate of XII Fulminata, claims the purple in Syria.
A truce is agreed between Lucius Vettius and Aulus Vitellius.
A truce is agreed between Aulus Vitellius and Servius Sulpicius Galba.
On the eve of battle, V Macedonica goes over to Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Quintus Numisius draws off.
Sohaemus of Emesa sends 3000 men to Quintus Numisius.
Aulus Vitellius buys I Italica.
A truce is agreed between Aulus Licinius and Quintus Annius.
Servius Sulpicius Galba falls back from Hispania Tarraconensis rather than fight Lucius Clodius Macer.
In Britain, Venutius leads the Brigantes in revolt.
Gaius Tettius, legate of XX Valeria Victrix, claims the purple in Britannia.
The Alpine chiefs send 2000 men to Aulus Vitellius.
The Senate recognises Aulus Vitellius as emperor.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Lucius Clodius Macer.
At Alexandria, the legions of the East hail Titus Flavius Vespasianus emperor. The last act begins.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Gallia Lugdunensis.
Aulus Vitellius falls back from Asia rather than fight Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
On the Rhine, the Batavian prince Julius Civilis stirs his people.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Alpes Maritimae.
The frontier breaks in Germania Inferior. Raiders burn the farms; no taxes will come from there for months.
On the eve of battle, V Macedonica goes over to Aulus Vitellius.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Servius Sulpicius Galba draws off.
V Alaudae joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Germania Inferior joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Alpes Cottiae.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Alpes Graiae et Poeninae.
II Augusta joins the army at Germania Superior.
IX Hispana joins the army at Germania Superior.
XX Valeria Victrix joins the army at Germania Superior.
Gallic levy joins the army at Raetia.
An alliance is agreed between Marcus Salvius Otho and Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Titus Flavius Vespasianus falls back from Asia rather than fight Aulus Vitellius.
A truce is agreed between Servius Sulpicius Galba and you.
A truce is agreed between Titus Flavius Vespasianus and you.
An alliance is agreed between Servius Sulpicius Galba and Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Battle near Roma: Servius Sulpicius Galba wins against Aulus Vitellius.
The Senate recognises Servius Sulpicius Galba as emperor.
The Garamantes raid the coast of Africa.
A truce is agreed between Servius Sulpicius Galba and Marcus Salvius Otho.
Titus Flavius Vespasianus buys VI Ferrata.
Titus Flavius Vespasianus buys X Fretensis.
Aulus Vitellius falls back from Aegyptus rather than fight Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
On the eve of battle, IV Macedonica goes over to Aulus Vitellius.
Battle near Lugdunum: Aulus Vitellius wins against the Senate.
Gallia Lugdunensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.
Gallia Lugdunensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.

storyLog.title: The temple treasure
storyLog.text: The gold is weighed out. The priests will not forget.

storyLog.title: A centurion is killed
storyLog.text: The lots are drawn. Nobody forgets it.

storyLog.title: An offer of marriage
storyLog.text: The wedding is quick, and well attended.

storyLog.title: A letter from Rome
storyLog.text: You will need the Senate later. Perhaps.

storyLog.title: The centurions come
storyLog.text: They will remember the promise, and the day it falls due.

storyLog.title: An informer
storyLog.text: Whether he was guilty, nobody now will know.

storyLog.title: A centurion is killed
storyLog.text: The lots are drawn. Nobody forgets it.

storyLog.title: Deserters
storyLog.text: They take the oath again, to you this time.

storyLog.title: An embassy of complaint
storyLog.text: He is hanged in the forum. The others are more careful, for a while.
